entities.summary: Aristide Pozzali was an Italian boxer. In 1951 he won the European Amateur Boxing Championships in Milan. He competed in the men's flyweight event at the 1952 Summer Olympics. At the 1952 Summer Olympics, he defeated Andrew Reddy of Ireland, before losing to Anatoli Bulakov of the Soviet Union.
